import urllib.request,json,pathlib
url='https://app.ontrackegy.com/ayo/'
with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'AYO-Mic-Policy-Diagnostic/1.0'}),timeout=8) as r:
 h=dict(r.headers);keys=['content-security-policy','permissions-policy','feature-policy','cross-origin-opener-policy','cross-origin-embedder-policy','x-frame-options','location']
 print(json.dumps({'status':r.status,'url':r.url,'policy_headers':{k:v for k,v in h.items() if k.lower() in keys},'server_text_html':r.headers.get('content-type'),'https':r.url.startswith('https://')}))
